_about: Crop parameters for the water balance. 'checked' lists the values read from the cited source, with the source key and the value as printed there; 'assumed' lists the values that are assumptions of the team, with the reason. Everything in 'assumed' is open for local agronomic advice.

_sources.FAO56_T17: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 17, basal crop coefficients Kcb. https://www.fao.org/4/x0490e/x0490e0c.htm
_sources.FAO56_T22: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 22, rooting depth Zr and depletion fraction p. https://www.fao.org/4/X0490e/x0490e0e.htm
_sources.FAO56_T11: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 11, lengths of crop development stages. https://www.fao.org/4/X0490e/x0490e0b.htm
_sources.MB_DAYS: Manitoba Agriculture. Agricultural Climate of Manitoba, Table 1: Number of Days Required for Selected Crops to Reach Maturity (used as a cold-continental analogue for season length). https://www.gov.mb.ca/agriculture/weather/agricultural-climate-of-mb.html
_sources.FAO56_T12: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 56, Table 12, single crop coefficients and mean maximum plant heights h. https://www.fao.org/4/X0490e/x0490e0b.htm
_sources.FAO33_KY: FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 33 (Doorenbos and Kassam, 1979), seasonal yield response factors Ky, as reproduced in FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper 66, Chapter 2, Table 1. https://fao.org/4/i2800e/i2800e02.pdf

wheat.name: Spring wheat
assumed: split of the season into stages

barley.name: Spring barley
assumed: split of the season into stages
ky (assumed equal to spring wheat; barley is not in the FAO33 excerpt we could read)

oats.name: Oats
assumed: split of the season into stages
ky (assumed equal to spring wheat; oats are not in the FAO33 excerpt we could read)

pea.name: Field pea (dry)
checked: root_depth_m (FAO56_T22, peas dry/seed: Zr 0.6-1.0 m; 0.8 used)

lentil.name: Lentil
assumed: split of the season into stages (FAO56_T11 gives 20/30/60/40 = 150 days for lentil planted in April in Europe; the 95-day season follows MB_DAYS)
ky (assumed equal to peas; lentil is not in the FAO33 excerpt we could read)

flax.name: Flax (oilseed)
assumed: split of the season into stages (FAO56_T11 gives 25/35/50/40 = 150 days for flax planted in April in Europe; the 100-day oilseed season follows MB_DAYS)
FAO-56 lists flax under fibre crops; its values are used here for oilseed flax
ky (assumed; flax is not in the FAO33 excerpt we could read)

B_pea.label: Pea instead of fallow: pea - wheat - wheat - barley

C_oats.label: Oats instead of fallow: oats - wheat - wheat - barley

_checked_on: FAO56_T11, T12, T17 and T22 re-read at the URLs above on 14 Nov 2026 for pea, flax, lentil and the cereals (task P1-1); no value had to change.

economics._about: Starting values for the money view. The farmer is expected to replace them. Prices are market quotes from the sources; average yields and costs are illustrative examples, not data.

_sources.ELEVATOR_AUG_2025: Elevator prices with VAT, Kazakhstan, August 2025 (Grain and oilseeds research bureau, via Bizmedia.kz). https://bizmedia.kz/2025-08-18-rekomendaczii-po-torgovoj-strategii-dlya-proizvoditelej-zerna-maslichnyh-i-bobovyh/
_sources.STAT_DEC_2024: Average farm-gate prices, December 2024, Bureau of National Statistics (via Dairynews). https://dairynews.today/kz/news/v-kazakhstane-tseny-na-zernovye-snizilis-a-maslichnye-podorozhali-v-dekabre-2024-goda.html
